title: L3HCTF 2024
description:
L3HCTF 2024 is a Jeopardy-style Online Capture The Flag Competition presented by L3H_Sec. The contest is opened to all participants around the world. Teams can compete from any location. No restriction on the number of participants of any team.
The Champion Team of L3HCTF 2024 will be invited to The Finals of the 8th Edition of XCTF(the location/date subject to change, qualified teams will be informed when the Finals location/date is confirmed).Other teams can also get the cumulative points to compete for other slots to The Finals of the 8th Edition of XCTF.

Competition Time
48 hours: From Feb.03，2024, 1 a.m. to Feb.05, 2024, 1 a.m(UTC).
prizes:
· 1st place 8,000 CNY (20% tax included), Qualified to The Finals of the 8th Edition of XCTF.
· 2nd place 5,000 CNY (20% tax included)
· 3rd place 3,000 CNY (20% tax included)
